fields.name: Child id
fields.definition: The second record-key column of a multi-column shard key (`ChildId`). The third and fourth columns are the grandchild id and great-grandchild id. They express a table whose primary key has more than one column, typically a parent id plus an id within that parent (an order and its line number). Like the record id, they are unique only in combination with the shard id.
